versions.changelog: Logo in the inbox (BIMI) check; list your monitored domains; check_record wait-or-edit verdict.

Email test: POST/GET /api/tools/email-test (send one real email to a single-use address, read SPF/DKIM/DMARC verdicts and an itemized score) and the token-gated GET /api/v1/email-tests history; retention 24 h without an account, 90 days with one; disclosure of what the email test keeps.
Neutral wording: describes what each endpoint returns, without promotional phrasing.
One DNS record sets a domain up: the DMARC record with your DNS Doctor report address proves ownership and starts the reports; the TXT ownership record is the alternative.
Adds the lookalike tools: a free check of a domain's closest look-alike names and a token-gated read of watched lookalikes.
20 tools: registration lookup (whois) added; linked-account monitoring tools for hosts that support OAuth linking; wider tool descriptions.
1.8.0: the REST skill text is unchanged from 1.7.5; this resyncs the listing number with the DNS Doctor release (intent-first tool descriptions on the hosted MCP server, skill disclosure section).
Same disclosure as 1.7.4; the monitoring-link sentence keeps the exact 'printed verbatim as a clickable markdown link' directive our published docs are pinned to. No API or workflow changes.

Discloses what the skill sends and where (one host, the domain the user asked about, scans are public report pages, the optional token goes to two reads only) and explains the monitoring link's ref=agent parameter. No API or workflow changes.
Propagation wording corrected: six vantage points on four continents (two probes are in North America). No workflow change.

Description names bulk scanning and the pay-per-call (x402) lane; new 'past the free limit' section; DMARC enforcement step corrected (a scan tops out at p=quarantine; p=reject needs aggregate-report evidence).
Graceful 402 handling for the new x402 agent-payment burst lane; tool surface unchanged at 16
RFC 9989 evidence-first ladder: pct deprecated, three-rung ladder, scan ceiling quarantine, reject via aggregate-report readiness only; t=y test-mode explained
Dual-protocol server (2026-07-28 Modern era + legacy on one endpoint); DNS-wide positioning; tool surface unchanged at 16.
check_propagation: multi-region DNS propagation verdicts from six vantage points (16th tool); teaches the verify-propagation step after publishing a record.
Assistants now print signup/report links verbatim as clickable links; description accuracy fixes. Content matches repo v1.4.1 (listing number is one ahead since the 1.4.1 migration increment).
Publisher consolidation: skill moved under the DNS Doctor publisher beside the plugin; content unchanged from 1.4.0

dns-doctor 1.4.0

- Improved documentation and usage guidance, clarifying when and how to use the skill for diagnosing email delivery/authentication issues.
- Expanded descriptions of API endpoints, including monitoring, focused checks, and proper handling of API tokens.
- Strengthened messaging on deterministic, validated fix records — never guessed or composed by users.
- Added examples and caveats for advanced checks (e.g., reverse DNS, SPF audit, parked-domain hardening).
- Emphasized user privacy, credential safety, and operational guidance on API limits and error handling.
